hook: Lady Juliana snaps her mother's journal shut and chillingly declares that the Dowager Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic.
cliffhanger: The door latch turns and the heavy door slowly opens while Juliana is caught mid-preparation with her antidote, ending on a suspenseful cliffhanger.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the high-stakes medical mystery and the immediate peril of being caught by an intruder.
narrative_context: Juliana identifies the cause of the Duchess's illness and races against time to concoct a remedy just as someone arrives at the door.
promotional_strength: Combines a gripping murder-mystery revelation with intense, high-stakes ticking-clock suspense as an intruder approaches.

evidence.observation: Juliana declares that someone is poisoning the Duchess.
Juliana identifies the poison as arsenic.
The door latch turns and opens, cutting to a cliffhanger.

logline: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Someone is poisoning her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Poison?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Arsenic.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Can you save her?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana uncorking a glass apothecary bottle as the Duchess rests behind her.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Focused, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I can try.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Top-down close-up of Juliana's soot-smudged hands pouring powdered activated charcoal from a vial into a stone mortar, then tossing in a pinch of crushed dried leaves.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's hands vigorously grinding the pestle inside the stone mortar.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Juliana... someone is coming.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.
